title: MULTI-SCORE

items: Zero-Shot Multimodal Retrieval with Multi-Scale Contextual Representations
Sourajit Saha and Tejas Gokhale, ACL 2026
Two-stage retrieval across text, image, video, and audio

note: 任务是相关性检索与重排。它没有给出重复关系、连通分量或训练数据删除策略。

title: Retrieval separates filtering from alignment

items: Stage 1 converts expensive corpus scoring into progressive embedding refinement.
Stage 2 applies fine-grained multimodal reasoning only to a candidate shortlist.
The method avoids task-specific fine-tuning while still relying on pretrained backbones.

note: Fine-tuning-free 不意味着零模型成本，也不意味着无需离线 caption 和 embedding。第 3 节。

title: Matryoshka representations support early rejection

items: Nested embedding prefixes provide several representation resolutions.
Pyramid Rank starts with short vectors and refines surviving candidates.
An admissible similarity upper bound determines which candidates can still cross the relevance threshold.

note: 上界与 epsilon 保证建立在论文的表示与排序假设下，不能直接推广到任意截断 embedding。第 3.1 节。

title: Pyramid Rank controls expensive similarity work

items: The algorithm searches a relevance threshold while climbing the representation pyramid.
Low-relevance candidates exit before full-dimensional dot products.
Offline captions support common text representations for heterogeneous corpus items.

note: caption 负责粗筛，会产生信息瓶颈。重排再强也无法挽回 Stage 1 已经丢掉的目标。

title: Bidirectional contextual scoring

items: Query-to-candidate and candidate-to-query prompts encode alignment in both directions.
The hidden state preceding an embedding marker aggregates the contextual prompt.
The contextual embedding score captures relations that isolated encoders can miss.

note: 这是使用 MLLM 表示的推理式相关性打分，不是训练一个新的双塔模型。第 3.2 节。

title: Question answering scores semantic coverage

items: The query becomes question–answer pairs.
Each candidate serves as evidence for answering those questions.
Answer agreement yields a relevance signal and a local explanation of ranking.

note: 生成问题质量、答案可判定性以及模型幻觉都会影响分数。可解释输出也需要审计。

title: Score fusion and candidate budgets

items: Stage 2 combines contextual and QA relevance with a weighting parameter.
Shortlist size determines how many native-modality inputs reach expensive inference.
Caption, embedding, and prompt versions jointly define a retrievable corpus snapshot.

note: 参数 alpha 与 top-K 均应作为检索配置版本保存。单独记录 embedding 模型不足以复现结果。

title: Published evaluation coverage
note: ACL 摘要与实验范围。结果依赖数据集、候选池和使用的 backbone，不能把所有任务均胜出作为结论。

title: Baselines and latency need common conditions

items: Compare zero-shot encoders, supervised retrieval, and naive multiscale filtering.
Separate offline caption/embedding cost from online Stage 1 and Stage 2 latency.
Reranking dominates the reported online budget in the implementation documentation.

note: 官方仓库 README 提供耗时与硬件设置，但不能把多 GPU batch 吞吐直接当作单请求延迟 SLO。

title: Failure modes and transfer limits

items: Stage 1 caption omissions reduce attainable recall.
QA and contextual prompts inherit backbone biases and domain sensitivity.
Retrieval relevance does not define a safe deduplication threshold or deletion policy.

note: 用于训练数据查重时还需独立标注 duplicate relation，并验证阈值和下游模型损失。论文未交付这个闭环。

title: Serving architecture implications

items: Inference: split cheap corpus filtering from independently scalable multimodal rerank workers.
Proposed application: cache caption and QA artifacts under content and model version keys.
Proposed application: monitor candidate recall and rerank quality separately.

note: 缓存是否安全取决于 prompt、backbone 与原始媒体版本。只缓存最终排序会隐藏错误来源。

title: Reproduction with a bounded corpus

items: Pin the paper implementation and backbone checkpoints before a small CPU/GPU budgeted run.
Compare Stage 1 alone, contextual scoring alone, QA alone, and full fusion.
Report recall at shortlist K, final retrieval metrics, offline GPU hours, and tail latency.

note: 官方代码可用，但本次仅阅读文档与论文，没有下载运行模型或验证实验数值。
